import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Try to find a link to the Members page
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members", exact=False)
    if await members_link.count() > 0:
        await members_link.click()
    else:
        # If link not found, navigate directly to the members page using relative URL
        await page.goto("/byteblaze/llm_bulk_inference/-/project_members")
    # Wait for the page to load
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
